CustomField.description: How many payments have actually been made on this gift (COUNT of payments where Paid = true). NPSP's npe01__Number_of_Payments__c counts EVERY payment including unpaid scheduled ones, so it cannot answer "how many payments has this donor made" - verified: three unpaid installments read 3. Pairs with npe01__Payments_Made__c (how much). JSI-126 / Jason Ott.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Number of payments actually paid on this gift (not counting unpaid scheduled installments).
CustomField.label: Payments Made (Count)
